HIGH COURT OF JAMMU & KASHMIR AND LADAKH
(Office of the Registrar General at Jammu)
*****
Advertisement Notice No: 04 o( 2022/RG
Dated: 19.11.2022
Subject: Advertisement for filling up of the posts of Adhoc Civil
Judge (Junior Division)/Munsiff.
a) Date of Commencement for submission of online applications =20.11.2022
b) Last Date for submission of onli ne applications = 19.12.2022
c) Last date for submission of onl ine fee of Rs. 300/- = 19.12.2022
Total Number of posts advertised = 65
Online applications are invited from t he cand idates who fulfil the
following eligibility conditions, for participating in t he selection process for the
posts of Adhoc Civil Judges (Junior Division)/ Munsiffs in t he UT of J&K and
Ladakh, as mentioned in Annexure-"A" to this Notification:
i. The candidate must be a domicile of UT of Jammu and Kashmir as
defined in Rule 3 of the Jammu and Kashmir Grant of Domicile
Certificate (Procedure) Rule, 2020 or resid ent of UT of Lada kh as
defined in Clause (4) of the Union Te rritory of Ladakh Resident
Certificate Order 2021.
ii. The candidate must possess a degree of 'Bachelor of Law' of a
University established by law in India; or
a Barrister of Engla nd or Northern Ireland or a member of the Faculty
of Advocates in Scotland or any other equivalent law degree
recognised by the Government of India.
iii. The candi date must not be more than 32 years of age as on
01.01.2022.
N2.t.e.i.
a. The term of adhoc appointment shall be for a maximum of two years or
till such time regular appointment is made which-ever is earlier.
b. The reservation for various categories would be determined as per t he
provisions of S.O. 127 dated 20.04.2020 .
c. In case the number of applications received is more tha n three times to
the number of posts advertised, the High Court may shortlist the number
of candidates for interview on the basis of marks secu red by the
candidates in the qualifying examination.
d. Applications will be received only through online mode on recruitment
portal of th e High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh, link of wh ich
wil l be activated on 20.11 .2022 on the webs ite of the High Court:
https: //www .jkhighcourt. nic.in.
e. No application shall be accepted I enterta ined after the last date.
f. The print-out of the application and required copies of documents shall be
kept ready to be submitted at the time of int erview.
g. The eligible cand idates shall have to appear in the viva-voce I Interview
on the date(s), to be notified separately, which shall be the selection
process . No se parate call letters shall be issu ed individually; however,
wide publ icity sha ll be given through print I electronic media and official
website https://www.jkhighcourt.nic.in of the High Court about the
venues of interview for the information of eligible candidates. No claim of
being unaware of the dates/schedule for interview shall be entertai ned.
h. No TA/DA shall be paid to the candidates for Viva-voce/Interview.
i. Qualification acquired after the last date of submission of application shall
not be taken for consi deration.
j. Before applying on line, the candidates are advised to carefully go through
the guidelines for online submission of forms. These guidelines will be
available on the online portal of the High Court.
By Order.
